purpose: Construct a deterministic untimed Richards comparator at equal-or-better realized error relative to the same REF-HIGH endpoint, using RossFast N=1 as the already frozen candidate production anchor. This separates strict realized-error matching from P2E22 threshold-matched timing.

reference_control_axis.reason: A dense, prospectively frozen integer control axis avoids post-hoc insertion of refinement levels after observed candidate/reference errors are known.
reference_control_axis.note: N=32 is the qualified REF-HIGH endpoint under the same representation-bounded policy, so the matching set is guaranteed to contain a zero-reference-error endpoint if its route and representation checks reproduce.

scientific_error_metric.storage: hard gate only: D_storage_abs <= exact-Se P2E14 storage envelope; storage is not included in E and is not scaled because the threshold is machine-scale
scientific_error_metric.mass: each accepted segment must have absolute typed integrated mass residual <= 1e-12 cm
scientific_error_metric.flux_identity: top and bottom prescribed transfers must close over the horizon

matching_rule.per_case: Let E_R be RossFast N=1 realized error. Traverse Reference N=1,2,...,32 in ascending order. Select N_hi as the first route-valid, storage-valid Reference configuration with E_ref <= E_R.
matching_rule.lower_bracket: Among valid Reference configurations with N < N_hi, retain the largest N whose E_ref > E_R as N_lo. If no such configuration exists, classify the match LEFT_CENSORED_AT_N1.
matching_rule.if_nonmonotone: The first valid crossing in ascending N remains authoritative. All later levels are still retained in output.

primary_endpoints.E3: realized error ratio E_ref(N_hi)/E_R and E_ref(N_lo)/E_R
primary_endpoints.E4: Reference work-counter vector at N_hi versus frozen RossFast N=1 vector
primary_endpoints.E5: route validity over all 1152 Reference matching configurations

secondary_endpoints: nonmonotonic Reference error trajectories across N
cases whose first crossing occurs only at N=32
cases left-censored because Reference N=1 is already at least as accurate as RossFast
distance between threshold-matched P2E22 N=1 and realized-error N_hi

required: 36 REF-HIGH reconstructions under exact P2E21 representation-bounded policy
same P2E14 thresholds and storage gates as P2E22

future_timing_boundary.if_P2E23_resolves_all_cases: A later timing workunit may time RossFast N=1 and Reference N_hi as the primary equal-or-better-error comparison, with N_lo optionally timed as a lower-cost error bracket.
future_timing_boundary.claim_wording_if_timed: Cost of RossFast N=1 versus the least-refined tested Richards configuration that achieves equal-or-better realized error to REF-HIGH.

next_permitted_action: Implement and execute the frozen 36-case, N=1..32 Reference matching matrix plus RossFast N=1 anchors. Do not perform timing.
